story.title: Awura Beauty, born to honor your crown
story.paragraph1: Awura Beauty was born from a simple truth: too many women with textured hair still have to settle for guesswork and formulas that don't truly understand them.
story.paragraph2: The brand was created to offer another path — one of listening, noble ingredients and personalized guidance, so every crown is treated with the respect it deserves.
story.paragraph3: From hair diagnostics to everyday care, Awura Beauty builds a complete experience: understand your hair, choose the right habits, and reclaim confidence in your natural beauty.
story.imageAlt: Textured hair highlighted with Awura Beauty care

mission.title: Our mission
mission.subtitle: Four pillars that guide every formula, every recommendation and every conversation with you.

expertise.title: Expertise & Care
expertise.body: Every crown is unique. We take time to understand your hair type, history and goals, so we can offer truly tailored advice — never one-size-fits-all solutions.

natural.title: Natural Ingredients
natural.body: Our formulas rely on botanical actives chosen for their efficacy: shea butter, coconut, plant oils and carefully selected extracts. Pure care that respects fiber and scalp.

results.title: Lasting Results
results.body: We don't chase artificial instant effects. Our method aims for visible, lasting results: hydration, density, softness and vitality built into a realistic routine.

love.title: Love & Authenticity
love.body: Awura Beauty was born out of love for our hair. Authenticity, pride and care sit at the heart of the brand — so you feel seen, understood and celebrated.

commitments.title: Our commitments
commitments.subtitle: What we promise, beyond the bottle.

naturality.title: Natural care
naturality.description: Nature-inspired formulas designed to respect your hair fiber and scalp every day.

crueltyFree.title: Cruelty-free
crueltyFree.description: Our products are not tested on animals. Responsible beauty, with no compromise on ethics.

artisanal.title: Artisanal making
artisanal.description: A careful, human approach: controlled batches and attention at every step of production.

cta.title: Ready to care for your crown?
cta.description: Start with a personalized hair diagnostic: we'll help you understand what your hair truly needs.
